svg.title: Forecasting sampled fields does not uniquely identify physical parameters
svg.desc: Exact alias control dt1/64; curves intentionally overlap. Five-percent-noise parameter medians use global validation-selected loops; negative inferred diffusivity is retained on symlog axes.
